name: Creeping Senility
body:
Type curse, disease; Save Will DC 19 negates, Will DC 19 to avoid effects; Onset 1 minute; Frequency 1/day

Effect

1d2 Int drain and 1d2 Wis drain.

Cure

Creeping senility can be cured only by successfully casting remove curse and restoration within 1 minute of each other. Additional castings of restoration are required to restore the drained ability scores.
